correctness.rationale: With u=sqrt(d), independent symbolic differentiation confirms 2sqrt(z)(1-u²z⁴)²F'(z)=Σ_{k=0}^3 a_k G_k(z). The strictly increasing h(z)=z/(1-z)-1/2-4u²z⁴/(1-u²z⁴) orders the four G_k zero crossings. The polynomial Wronskians -W(G0+uG2,G3), -W(G1,G3), -W(G2,G3) factor as stated; Q13,Q23 have positive u=1 lower bounds, and Q_A is strictly concave in u with positive endpoint bounds. For b≥u, -W(G0+aG1+bG2,G3)>0, hence H/G3 decreases from +infinity to -infinity on (0,r3), producing exactly one zero and hence a strict interior maximum. Four independent exact rational derivative-sign checks at z=1/2,3/5,3/4,9/10 give +,-,+,- for (d,a,b,c)=(49/50,1/1000,1/1000,73/100), hence at least three distinct critical points. The universal proof is analytic; the symbolic checks only corroborate identities.
